subject: Mathematics
questionText: In the graph of the hyperbola shown, what is the equation of the asymptote of the hyperbola given by the equation y^2/4 - x^2/9 = 1?
correctExplanation: The equation of the asymptote of a hyperbola is y = ±(a/b)x. Here, a = 2 and b = 3, so the equation of the asymptote is y = ±2x/3.
